title: PokemonBattleTalkDecision
description: Schema for LLM Model 2: Battle Talk Dialogue, Intent, Tactical Advice & Morale

dialogue.description: In-battle dialogue, emotional cry, or descriptive combat emote

intent.description: Interpreted communicative intent of the trainer's or opponent's message

emotional_state.description: In-combat emotional state (focused, defiant, pleased, nervous, exhausted, fired_up, combative, composed, gleeful, cocky, malicious, thoughtful, recovering)

morale_delta.description: Temporary impact on combat morale and momentum

tactical_reaction.description: Immediate tactical physical response (brace, strike, reposition, nod, hesitate)

tactical_suggestion.description: Optional recommended attack move or switch action

momentum_tier.description: Battle momentum tier calculated from HP difference, morale, and bond

morale_effect.description: Active combat morale effect or status descriptor

confidence.description: Confidence score of the intent interpretation and response
